text:
{"content":""leave Save unavailable"

What does that mean? Disabled? Or that the button isn't shown at all? ","codeSuggestion":"","assessment":"The reviewer asks whether unavailable means disabled or hidden. Your instruction changes the required behavior: missing title/dateTime helpers or validators must not disable create Save. Use the registered fields and call their available validators. Revise the controller, button condition, documentation, and tests together.","rationale":"The controller and renderer currently require specific title/dateTime helpers. The field loops already support other registered fields and optional validators. The historical missing-helper note and existing fields:{} assertion describe the previous design; they do not override your instruction. Removing the helper guards alone is incomplete: isCalendarEventDraftValid also checks stored errors for fields that are absent from the current field map. Create Save must use validation for the supplied enabled fields and retain the independent calendar permission check.","recommendation":"change","validation":"Inspected saveCalendarEventCreate, #renderSave(), prepareCalendarEventSave, isCalendarEventDraftValid, the focused unit and browser tests, and knowledge note 9d416e962b61d586fcb7677f3d4dfffece630bb24879286fa12ff4a25ceed186. Ran node --input-type=module with the current controller and actual preparation and validity functions in memory. Store, Calendar, and transaction dependencies were simulated. Removing the fixed helper guards allowed partial fields and absent validators. Invalid present fields and an unwritable calendar still prevented transactions. An invalid result for an absent field still blocked Save. No files changed. No mach or browser tests ran during this step because they write files. Earlier passing tests cover the previous behavior. Real transaction and UI validation for the requested behavior remains incomplete.","appliedSummary":"Updated the controller, dialog, helper documentation, and unit and browser tests. Create Save now uses available validators and ignores errors for absent fields. Calendar, request, and edit checks remain.

Lint, formatting, syntax, and whitespace checks passed. Six controller tasks passed in Node with simulated Calendar services. The diff follows the recorded evidence.

Native and browser tests remain unrun under the generated-file restriction. The evidence assessment remains incomplete. All five files remain unstaged.","changeSummary":"Remove title/dateTime-specific helper guards from calendar-event-create-save.mjs and helper-based create-button disabling from calendar-event-create-edit-dialog.mjs. Limit create field validation to supplied enabled fields so absent-field results cannot block Save. Retain live calendar checks, session ownership, duplicate-request protection, failure retention, and edit Save validation. Update the helper requirement text in both JSDoc locations. Replace the old missing-helper assertion and add unit and browser coverage for partial fields, missing validators, absent-field errors, invalid present fields, disabled rows, and an enabled create Save button without fixed helper registrations.","state":"handled","changeAccepted":false,"changeReverted":false,"changesAmended":true}
title: D332899: Author kept a prepared review change
